query:
UPDATE git_sync_ci_test_check
                         SET github_posted = github_posted
                                 AND check_run_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM GREATEST(check_run_id, $3),
                             check_run_id = GREATEST(check_run_id, $3)
                         WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND repo_resource_path = $4 AND head_sha = $2
